newsitem.title: UK: Argos leads sector higher on budget hopes.
newsitem.headline: Argos leads sector higher on budget hopes.

text.p: Shares in major UK retailers rebounded on Monday amid growing hopes that the chancellor would deliver a prudent budget on Tuesday to steer clear of another interest rate hike before the general election, dealers said.

At 1513 GMT, Argos climbed 14p to 780-1/2p, Boots added 12p to 633p, Marks & Spencer firmed 9-1/2p to 500p, while Great Universal Stores was up 8p to 672p. Kingfischer, which last week stumbled to its lowest level since July, rose 11p to 638-1/2p.
"People are presuming the budget will be good for the consumer," said one marketmaker.
But the retail sector, he noted, had been underperforming the broad market recently and was now just catching up.
